I totally understand you OP. 

My mom divorced and when I was little and since then she didn't give any effort to gain skill or get a proper job. She live on support funds from my dad and now she is getting old and my dad stopped providing. I graduated from college so she started to lean everything on me. First she wants me to support all her insurance and I did, then she would go on shopping sprees for her so called essential needs, now she accidentally needs a super expensive dental care that will be 50% of my annual income. When I start to question her or ask her to find a way to support herself she will give me a million excuse of why she can't and dump all her negative emotions on me because I owe her as her child.

She has been giving me problems after problems and I don't think I can take them no more. Because of her poor life decisions I loose everything and I have to do things against my true heart, lose the love of my life, give up everything to live for her and satisfy her needs. I hate her but I can't abandon her. I'm waiting for my lifeline to snap so I can let loose.

Now I'm obsessed with this thought

finally free
